title: bug: submit_plan accepts plan data it then silently truncates or crashes on: steps 51-100 of an accepted plan are dropped by the plan sanitizer (validators.ts keeps 50 while submit_plan allows 100), and planningNotes is neither type-checked nor bounded (a non-string throws an uncoded TypeError, a string keyFiles is stored raw, text over 5000 chars is clipped)
description:
Filed by the governor from hunt #15's two held plan-intake items (task-928a468d, architect-1dd28c7c, msg-492975dd). They are combined here because both break the same rule in the same handler: a submit_plan input is refused, never truncated or coerced. Re-verified at tip f76c55f3. It waits in BACKLOG on task-87cba58c, which also edits submitPlan.ts. The governor promotes it when 87cba58c is DONE.

PROBLEM 1, the step bound
packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/submitPlan.ts:352 allows up to 100 steps, and settings.taskSizing.maxSteps validates up to 100. sanitizeImplementationPlan (state/validators.ts:775, `plan.slice(0, 50)`) runs on every task write and keeps only the first 50. So steps 51+ of an accepted plan are silently dropped from memory and disk. It is reachable only with a custom taskSizing.maxSteps above 50; the default refuse line is 12. Evidence: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-928a468d/B/planStepCap.test.ts, run at d5431577; output in planStepCap.output.txt. A 60-step plan is accepted, and 50 steps are stored, in memory and after a reload.

PROBLEM 2, planningNotes
submitPlan.ts:565-570 copies planningNotes with `.slice(0, 5000)` and `keyFiles?.slice(0, 50)`, with no type checks:
- A non-string field (for example risks: 42) throws an uncoded TypeError.
- A string keyFiles is stored as a string, although the schema says string[].
- A 6000-char note is clipped to 5000 with no error.
The sibling executionContract in the same handler refuses an oversized field with INVALID_INPUT, "nothing is truncated or coerced". Evidence: B/planningNotesIntake.test.ts, run at d5431577; output in planningNotesIntake.output.txt. Three cases fail; the executionContract control case passes.

FIX DIRECTION
Make the bounds agree. Either refuse steps above 50 at submit_plan (and cap taskSizing.maxSteps at 50 in its validator), or raise the sanitizer cap to the accepted 100; say which in the plan. Validate planningNotes like executionContract: each text field a string within the limit (refused INVALID_INPUT, never clipped), keyFiles a string[] with bounded length. Error handling is coded INVALID_INPUT throughout. Sync submit_plan's MCP_SERVER.md section and, if the step cap changes, taskSizing in docs/CONFIGURATION.md (ruling msg-71db57ac).

FILES
submitPlan.ts, state/validators.ts, one vitest file, and docs. Gate: that vitest file plus submitPlan.test.ts, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout (global rail).
definitionOfDone: Every step of an accepted plan is stored. A plan over the effective bound is refused INVALID_INPUT at submit_plan, never truncated later. The hunt planStepCap cases pass, adjusted to whichever bound ships.

A non-string planningNotes field, a non-array keyFiles and an over-limit note are each refused INVALID_INPUT, nothing clipped or stored raw. The planningNotesIntake cases pass, and the executionContract control is unchanged.
submit_plan's MCP_SERVER.md section (and CONFIGURATION.md's taskSizing, if its limit changed) state the bounds, and submitPlan.test.ts passes.

Expect success and stepCount 60, metrics.plannedStepCount 60, 60 steps in memory with the last stepId 'step-60', 60 on disk, and 60 after a new StateManager load. implementationPlan.description:
Implement. Edit tool only.
(a) packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts:
- Add `export const MAX_PLAN_STEPS = 100;` beside the contract caps, after MAX_REQUIRED_CHECKS (:130). Doc comment: it is the most steps one plan may hold; submit_plan refuses more, taskSizing warnSteps and maxSteps validate up to it, and sanitizeImplementationPlan keeps exactly this many. It is one number, like the step caps in util/planSize; the sanitizer kept 50 while submit_plan accepted 100. It lives here, not in util/planSize, so the plan stays at 5 files and the standard tier.
- sanitizeImplementationPlan (:775) becomes `plan.slice(0, MAX_PLAN_STEPS)`.
- The taskSizing validator (:490 and :493): the warnSteps and maxSteps upper bound becomes MAX_PLAN_STEPS. The value stays 100; the two are now tied.
- Add validatePlanningNotes(value, fieldName = 'planningNotes') beside validateExecutionContract, with exported MAX_PLANNING_NOTE_CHARS = 5000, MAX_PLANNING_KEY_FILES = 50, MAX_PLANNING_KEY_FILE_CHARS = 1000 and a PlanningNotes interface:
  - undefined or null → undefined;
  - requirePlainObject, then rejectUnknownFields over the four keys;
  - each text field through validateStringValue({ maxLength 5000, allowEmpty: true, allowNewlines: true }), skipping null or undefined;
  - keyFiles not an array → invalidInput('planningNotes.keyFiles', 'must be an array of strings'); more than 50 → 'must contain 50 items or fewer';
  - each keyFiles entry through validateStringValue({ maxLength 1000 }) at `planningNotes.keyFiles[i]`.
  No trimming and no path normalization: keyFiles are informational and may be absolute scratch paths.
(b) packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/submitPlan.ts:
- Import validatePlanningNotes, MAX_PLAN_STEPS and the three note caps in the existing '../state/validators.js' import block (:6-9).
- Right after `const measuredContract = validateExecutionContract(...)` (:302), add `const planningNotes = validatePlanningNotes((args as { planningNotes?: unknown } | null)?.planningNotes);`. A bad note is then refused before the Git reads, the mutex and any write.
- :352-353 becomes `params.steps.length > MAX_PLAN_STEPS` → invalidInput('steps', `maximum ${MAX_PLAN_STEPS} steps allowed`). The message text is unchanged.
- :571-578 becomes `if (planningNotes) updatePayload.planningNotes = planningNotes;` with no slice. Drop planningNotes from the inner params cast (:329-334).
- inputSchema: steps `maxItems: MAX_PLAN_STEPS`; the three note strings `maxLength: MAX_PLANNING_NOTE_CHARS`; keyFiles `maxItems: MAX_PLANNING_KEY_FILES`, with items of `maxLength: MAX_PLANNING_KEY_FILE_CHARS`.
Error handling: every new refusal is a coded INVALID_INPUT, raised through invalidInput, requirePlainObject, rejectUnknownFields or validateStringValue, and carries context.field. Each is thrown before any write, and nothing is clipped or coerced. Omitted planningNotes still keeps a stored set, as today.

2. Put MAX_PLAN_STEPS in util/planSize.ts beside the other step caps. Rejected: with the required B28 test update it makes 6 files, and the plan size floor then puts the task in the heavy tier. validators.ts already hosts the contract caps.
